62/G.goal: Develop and demonstrate a Unity-based XR application by setting up C# scripting, implementing interactive behavior, building the application, and integrating a Vuforia augmented-reality SDK.
62/G.achieves: It gives the learner the practical Unity and Vuforia implementation skills needed to understand and implement an XR system with confidence.

62/O1.goal: Set up a Unity C# scripting environment and inspect the basic structure, variables, and console output of a Unity script.
62/O1.achieves: It gives the learner the practical Unity foundation needed to begin scripting customized XR behavior.

62/O2.goal: Implement scripted interactive behavior for Unity game objects using event responses, runtime object creation, control-flow logic, and timed Transform or opacity changes.
62/O2.achieves: It lets the learner turn a static Unity scene into an interactive XR scene that can be built or extended further.

62/O3.goal: Add user input handling to a Unity script and build or deploy the application from the Unity editor.
62/O3.achieves: It lets the learner produce a runnable XR application and test user interaction on a target platform.

62/O4.goal: Integrate a platform-specific augmented-reality SDK into Unity and configure, build, and demonstrate a Vuforia marker-based AR sample.
62/O4.achieves: It lets the learner connect Unity to AR hardware capabilities and produce a working marker-based AR demonstration.
